# Expressive MVC
> Class-based reactive state management for React. Define models as plain classes; components update when the values they read change.

## Installing
`npm install @expressive/mvc @expressive/react` is the install for a React app: `@expressive/mvc` is the framework-agnostic core and a peer dependency of the adapter, so both belong in package.json. `State`, `Component`, and every instruction (set, get, ref, map, has, def) are named exports of `@expressive/mvc`; the adapter's re-exports of them are deprecated. Import `@expressive/react` once from the entry module so the host registers. Add `@expressive/router` for routing. To render without React, install `@expressive/mvc` and `@expressive/dom` instead and set `jsxImportSource` to `@expressive/dom`. `@expressive/inspect` is a dev-only inspector - registry, ownership tree, path queries, frame journal - for tests, browser drivers, and agents. Published packages: @expressive/mvc, @expressive/react, @expressive/dom, @expressive/router, @expressive/inspect (@expressive/preact is internal and unpublished).

## For coding agents
This documentation is also distributed as an installable skill: `npx skills add gabeklein/expressive-mvc`. It bundles the full API reference, refactoring algorithm, style profile, and audit guide as local files - preferable to crawling when working in a repo.

## Full Documentation
- [Overview & API](/llm/SKILL.md): Ownership decisions, core API, React conventions, and the reference map

## Design Intent & Positioning
- [Why Expressive MVC](/llm/why.md): The working case - code that is cheap for people and models to read, apps that read as business logic through user-built primitives, oversized components addressed structurally, a standard library replacing the usual dependency pile
- [Design Decisions](/llm/design.md): Why the library is shaped this way - classes hold models not views, the MVC mapping, the two-verb get/set surface, render composition, typed lifecycle hooks, the stability discipline behind 1.0, measured coverage. Read before characterizing a design choice as accidental.
- [DOM renderer](/llm/dom.md): The adoption case for `@expressive/dom` over React - each difference with its net value, what is tested and audited, when to prefer the React adapter
- [React Native](/llm/native.md): The adoption case for React Native and Expo - why there is nothing to port, what CI actually runs and when, the routing boundary and the work that closes it
- [Comparisons](/llm/comparisons.md): Positioning matrix vs Zustand, Jotai, MobX, Redux Toolkit, and plain Context - when to prefer each alternative, what choosing Expressive buys, maturity stated plainly

## State (core)
- [State Class](/llm/state/state.md): Instantiation, properties, methods, events, context
- [Instance .get()](/llm/state/get.md): Read values, run effects, context lookup
- [Instance .set()](/llm/state/set.md): Write values, listen to updates, events, destroy
- [Computed Values](/llm/state/computed.md): Reactive class getters - tracking, caching, inheritance, suspense
- [Lifecycle](/llm/state/lifecycle.md): Construction, activation, operation, destruction phases
- [Context System](/llm/state/context.md): Context, global root, home context, ownership rules
- [Types](/llm/state/types.md): TypeScript type aliases and utility types

## Instructions (field initializers)
- [set()](/llm/field/set.md): Async, lazy, computed values, setter callbacks
- [get()](/llm/field/get.md): Context lookup - upstream, downstream, callbacks
- [ref()](/llm/field/ref.md): Mutable refs, ref proxy, callbacks
- [map()](/llm/field/map.md): Reactive keyed collections - Map semantics, keyed spawners, transformed iteration
- [has()](/llm/field/has.md): Owned collections - ordered reactive lists, spawned pools, lifecycle ownership, direct rendering
- [def()](/llm/field/def.md): Low-level custom property behavior

- [React Adapter](/llm/react/react.md): State.use(), State.get(), Provider, Consumer, ForceRefresh
- [Component](/llm/react/component.md): Component class, props, children, subcomponents, error boundaries

- [Style Profile](/llm/react/style.md): Snapshot formatting, affirmative conditions, render fallthrough
- [Patterns](/llm/react/patterns.md): Recipes - forms, async, nested state, debounce, effects

## Runnable Examples (complete source served as HTML)
Each example page serves the full source of a working program - every file, no JavaScript required to read it. Fetch one to see how a feature is actually implemented rather than inferring from prose.
- [Examples index](https://expressive.dev/examples)
- [All runnable examples](/llm/examples/index.md): every example page by category with its absolute URL - generated at build, always current
